Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
chw...@fairesuivre.com wrote:
>
> Sorry again, I think most of past messages talked about that, but what
> happens when a vampire has base strengh of two (as said on the card :
> +1 hand damage) ?
> the vampire play superior torn signpost and has 4 damage hand strikes,
> or 3 damage hand strikes ?

The vampire has a base strength of 1. He also has a +1 modifier.
If he changes his base strength to 3 with Torn Signpost, he'll have
a total of 4 strength.
